judged_text: add_members silently skips any username that matches no user and still returns success_json, and this diff deletes the spec ('succeeds silently when adding non-existent users') that pinned exactly that behavior. An admin who typos a username in the free-text 'enter username' field gets a success response and a member-list reload that simply lacks the user, with no error anywhere — and no test remains to catch a future change to this silent-skip behavior.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the loop only adds when `User.find_by_username(username)` returns a user and otherwise does nothing, yet the action still proceeds to `group.save` and renders `success_json` on success (even if zero users were added). This makes typos in the free-text `usernames` field silently succeed with no feedback. The diff also removes the prior spec that explicitly asserted silent success when adding a non-existent user (`"succeeds silently when adding non-existent users"`), and no equivalent test is added for the new `add_members` behavior, so this UX/behavior is now unpinned by tests.
